voice: Thandi (ElevenLabs eleven_v4, BcpjRWrYhDBHmOnetmBl) single take, 18 Nov 2026

lines.text: Three withdrawals. About R75,900 less at retirement.
And it's not rare! In March, Momentum said more than 60% of two-pot claims were third withdrawals.
So say you take R10,000, three years in a row. That's R30,000 out.
Each time it's taxed at your marginal rate, and there's a fee.
But the real cost? Growth. Left in the fund for about 20 more years, at 5% a year above inflation, that R30,000 becomes about R75,900 in today's money.
Full two-pot guide on the channel.
So before you tap withdraw again, remember...
